studies.Title: Prospective study of dietary supplements, macronutrients, micronutrients, and risk of bladder cancer in US men.
studies.Reference: Prospective study of dietary supplements, macronutrients, micronutrients, and risk of bladder cancer in US men.

extraction_supporting_text.cases: During 12 years of follow-up, 320 cases of bladder cancer were diagnosed.
extraction_supporting_text.design: The authors examined the relations between intakes of macro- and micronutrients and the risk of bladder cancer among men in the prospective Health Professionals Follow-Up Study.
extraction_supporting_text.timing: During 12 years of follow-up, 320 cases of bladder cancer were diagnosed.
extraction_supporting_text.continent: bladder cancer is the fourth leading cause of cancer in men in the United States
extraction_supporting_text.exposure_measurement: Each participant completed a 131-item food frequency questionnaire in 1986 and in 1990, from which nutrient intakes were calculated.
extraction_supporting_text.gender: among men in the prospective Health Professionals Follow-Up Study
